review.reason: Adds warehouse query result parsing and display capability, allowing warehouse users to view JSON-formatted results in a modal rather than raw strings.
review.uncertainty: This is a localized UI improvement. The tier is assigned based on the observed addition of a JSON parsing and display feature, which is a substantive bounded capability. No broader systemic changes or unverified adoption metrics are present. The benefit is demonstrated by the code, not by external claims.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier requires assessment.

observations.behavior: Adds import of tryJsonParse, a new state variable selectedJson, and a conditional JSON parsing and display block.
observations.code_quote: <LemonModal title="JSON" isOpen={selectedJson !== null} onClose={() => setSelectedJson(null)} width={800}>
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse query results displayed in OutputPane to be parsed and shown as a modal if the value is JSON, rather than displaying raw strings.
